evidenceLine.cypher:
(conceptB:`Disease`)<-[_r:`studies condition`]-(scoringAndUniqueNode:`ClinicalTrial`)-[_r2:`using the drug`]->(d:`Drug`)-[_r3:`acts on`]->(conceptA:`Gene`)
